rationale: GpuCompute WaveNet compute path only: wavenet_forward_batch encodes several instances into one submit and readback, activation history moves from per-block copies to column rings indexed by a stream position, and the layer shader covers several samples per workgroup. Outputs are bit-identical to the previous kernels and covered by pulp-test-gpu-compute. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves; no UI paint path changes.
